overlay.deck.export.subtitle: Includes the share code and card list
overlay.deck.help.steps:
1  Copy the PVZH1 code, raw Base64URL payload, or full deck text.

2  Tap Import deck to create a new deck.

3  Missing cards are skipped. Incompatible cards or more than four copies of a card are rejected.

4  If the deck does not appear immediately, return to the deck screen or restart the game.

5  To export, choose a side, hero, and deck, then copy the full text.
overlay.deck.help.disclaimer:
Disclaimer

This feature is for sharing and managing local decks. It does not change card counts, grant missing cards, or bypass payment, authentication, or anti-cheat checks. Back up important data before using it.
